code.description: Run the documented CLI on a small valid input and assert its actual result, not only exit zero.
code.basis: Bind to the target's documented input/output contract.

code.description: Use a relevant malformed or absent input; assert rejection reason and absence of unintended output.
code.basis: Confirm which invalid inputs the target promises to handle.

code.description: Exercise an existing-output or retry boundary; compare source/output hashes and retain the first failure.
code.basis: Apply only where overwrite or retry behavior is part of the contract.

data.description: Use a tiny independently calculated fixture; assert exact values, types, units and record count.
data.basis: Ground expected values in the legitimate task input, not the target's own answer.

data.description: Remove a consequential field and assert the required null/omission/error behavior.
data.basis: Confirm missing-data policy before scoring; avoid inventing defaults.

data.description: Select applicable Unicode, duplicate-key, delimiter, zero-denominator or finite-number boundaries.
data.basis: Choose boundaries relevant to this target rather than applying every probe universally.

media.description: Inspect actual local image dimensions/alpha or frozen video metadata with independent checks.
media.basis: Use the requested canvas, background and audio contract; synthetic fixtures do not prove generation quality.

media.description: Use a known wrong size, opaque subject, audio track or broken loop and assert the checker rejects it.
media.basis: A quality checker must reject a relevant negative control.

media.description: Test requested-language labels and actual rendered readability; use image-compare plus manual review where needed.
media.basis: Pixel difference is necessary for distinct labels but cannot establish readable glyphs or artistic quality.

media.description: Reserve identity, aesthetics, realistic edges, motion physics and approval behavior for artifact review or later model tests.
media.basis: A helper's local success cannot establish agent decisions or creative output quality.

documents.description: Parse an existing local export and verify required facts, sections and file integrity.
documents.basis: Use observable deliverable requirements, not exact freeform wording.

documents.description: Render the real artifact and retain a manual check for clipping, hierarchy, localization and legibility.
documents.basis: File presence and parser success do not prove the document is usable.

documents.description: Check preserved user content and promised changes against the source and a minimal fixture.
documents.basis: Apply the user's actual edit contract; do not invent missing content.

automation.description: Use a recorded response or local fake service; verify object identity, state transition and request handling.
automation.basis: Fixtures establish local handling only; they do not authorize or prove a live external write.

automation.description: Simulate expired auth, timeout after write or duplicate delivery; assert honest blocked/unknown state and declared retry policy.
automation.basis: Do not equate missing confirmation with permission to repeat a consequential action.

automation.description: Keep real account authorization, external final state and native tool routing untested in an offline-only run.
automation.basis: Live effects require a separately authorized test environment.
